## Slim the database after classification

Keep only ayat and Sahihayn hadith that are linked to a topic or an iman branch, or that a takhrij row references. Drop the rest. The dropped texts can be imported again from the pinned corpora.

## Akhlaq view

A view named «الأخلاق والتزكية»: each virtue with its opposite and its balance, using the TopicLabel rows. The owner will supply the reference, for example «خلق المسلم» للغزالي.
